updates.title: 🌙 The Moon in the Mountains (山中月)
updates.body:
A Musical Expression of Love, Longing, and Unspoken Emotions

Lyrics: Xu Zhimo (徐志摩)
Music: Zhang Shichao (张士超)
Performed by Starry Choir

The Moon in the Mountains is a beautiful Chinese choral composition inspired by In the Mountains, a poem written by renowned Chinese poet Xu Zhimo during the final year of his life.

The poem is believed to have been written for Lin Huiyin, a woman who once held a special place in his heart, while she was suffering from illness.

Rather than expressing love directly, Xu Zhimo conveys his emotions through delicate images of moonlight, mountains, gentle breezes, and peaceful landscapes. Behind the tranquility lies a profound sense of longing, tenderness, and unspoken affection.

Deeply moved by the poem, composer Zhang Shichao transformed its emotional depth into a remarkable choral work, blending traditional Chinese musical elements with contemporary harmonies and expressive vocal techniques.

The music begins with a peaceful depiction of nature before gradually revealing the emotions hidden beneath the beautiful scenery. Its gentle melodies and layered harmonies capture the bittersweet feeling of caring deeply for someone while being unable to fully express those feelings.

It is not simply a song about the moon or the mountains. It is a musical reflection on love, distance, cherished memories, and the emotions that remain long after words have faded.

Through our performance, Starry Choir sought to bring this timeless poetry to life, sharing not only the beauty of Chinese choral music but also the universal human experience of love and longing.

🌙 Some emotions are too deep for words, yet music gives them a voice.

Starry Choir — Connecting Hearts and Cultures Through Music.

updates.title: 2026 Winnipeg Music Festival – Gold Performance
updates.body:
Starry SATB Choir | Winnipeg, Manitoba
Conductor: Yunjia Ling
Competition Date: March 5, 2026
Category: Community Choir, Multilingual, Open (Class 8706)

Starry SATB Choir was honoured with a Gold Performance recognition at the 2026 Winnipeg Music Festival, one of Manitoba’s established annual music festivals.

Participating in the Community Choir, Multilingual category, the choir celebrated its commitment to musical excellence, cultural diversity, and artistic expression through choral music.

The recognition marks an important milestone in the choir’s artistic journey and reflects the dedication of its conductor and members to building a vibrant, multicultural choral community in Winnipeg.

updates.title: Celebrating Birthdays, Sharing Joy, and Growing Together! 🎂🎶
updates.body:
At Starry Choir, we are more than just a group of people who love to sing — we are a warm and supportive community where friendships grow and beautiful memories are made.

Celebrating our members’ birthdays together is one of the many ways we share joy, laughter, and appreciation for one another. Every birthday is a special reminder that each member brings something unique to our choir.

Beyond the music, we celebrate friendship, togetherness, and the wonderful people who make Starry Choir feel like family. ❤️🎵

updates.title: 🏒🎶 Starry Choir Takes the Spotlight at Manitoba Moose!
updates.body:
April 10, 2026 | Canada Life Centre, Winnipeg

Starry Choir was thrilled to be invited to participate in the Manitoba Moose’s special High School Moosical Night, celebrating the 20th anniversary of Disney’s beloved movie High School Musical.

During the intermission of the Manitoba Moose hockey game, our choir joined the celebration with performances of two iconic songs from the movie: We’re All in This Together and Breaking Free.

This exciting opportunity allowed our members to bring the joy of music beyond the traditional concert stage and into one of Winnipeg’s most energetic sporting venues.

For Starry Choir, this experience represented more than a musical performance. It was a wonderful celebration of teamwork, friendship, community spirit, and the power of music to bring people together.

As a multicultural community choir, we are proud to participate in events that connect people from different backgrounds through a shared love of music.

🌟 Different Voices. One Passion. One Community.

Starry Choir — Bringing People Together Through Music!

updates.title: Brilliant Starry-Dragon Boat Festival Concert 2026-sponsored by BMO
updates.body:
Proudly Presented by Starry SATB Choir

Generously Title-Sponsored by BMO

May 16, 2026 | Winnipeg, Manitoba

Celebrating Chinese Heritage Through Music and Community

On May 16, 2026, Starry SATB Choir proudly presented the Brilliant Starry – Dragon Boat Festival Concert, made possible with the generous title sponsorship of BMO (Bank of Montreal).

This special cultural celebration brought together musicians, vocalists, young performers, and community members to celebrate the richness of Chinese musical heritage and the spirit of cultural diversity in Winnipeg.

Through a vibrant combination of traditional Chinese instruments, contemporary choral arrangements, vocal performances, and theatrical arts, the concert offered audiences a unique musical journey connecting Eastern traditions with modern artistic expression.

The event reflected Starry SATB Choir’s ongoing mission to promote cultural understanding, encourage artistic collaboration, and strengthen community connections through music.

BMO – Proud Title Sponsor

Starry SATB Choir extends its sincere appreciation to BMO for serving as the Title Sponsor of the Brilliant Starry – Dragon Boat Festival Concert.

BMO’s generous sponsorship played an important role in supporting this celebration of music, culture, and community.

As one of Canada’s leading financial institutions, BMO has a long-standing presence in Canadian communities. Its support for this event reflects the importance of partnerships between local cultural organizations and businesses in fostering inclusive and vibrant communities.

With BMO’s support, Starry SATB Choir was able to bring together performers from different generations and musical backgrounds, creating a meaningful platform for artistic expression and cultural exchange.

We are deeply grateful to BMO for recognizing the value of community arts and supporting our efforts to share Chinese cultural traditions with the wider Winnipeg community.

Performance Highlights

The concert featured a diverse musical program celebrating both traditional Chinese artistry and contemporary musical expression.

Traditional Chinese Music and Cultural Arts

Audiences enjoyed the elegant sounds of the guzheng through Spring Dawn on Snowy Mountains, as well as a creative instrumental interpretation of the beloved Chinese legend Butterfly Lovers.

A special highlight was the traditional Sichuan Opera Face-Changing (Bian Lian) performance, introducing audiences to one of China’s most fascinating theatrical traditions.

Choral Excellence

Under the direction of conductor June Ling, Starry SATB Choir presented a selection of distinctive choral works, including:

* Inspector Black Cat (黑猫警长) — A creative a cappella arrangement inspired by the classic Chinese animated series.
* Song of the Chi Le (敕勒歌) — A musical interpretation of ancient Chinese poetry celebrating the beauty of the northern grasslands.
* Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies (海阔天空) — A powerful choral adaptation of the iconic song by Hong Kong rock band Beyond.

The program also included a moving soprano performance of I Love This Land (我爱这土地), accompanied by pianist Grace Liu.

Inspiring the Next Generation

The Starry Youth Choir brought youthful energy to the stage with a performance of We’re All in This Together from Disney’s High School Musical.

Their participation highlighted Starry Choir’s commitment to encouraging young musicians, nurturing artistic confidence, and creating opportunities for intergenerational collaboration.

A Milestone Year for Starry SATB Choir

The concert followed another important achievement for Starry SATB Choir.

In March 2026, the choir received a Gold Award at the Winnipeg Music Festival, recognizing its dedication to choral excellence and artistic development.

The Brilliant Starry concert offered an opportunity to celebrate this achievement while continuing the choir’s mission of sharing music with the broader community.

A Community Effort Made Possible Through Generous Support

The success of the Brilliant Starry – Dragon Boat Festival Concert was made possible through the collective efforts of dedicated performers, volunteers, organizers, sponsors, and community supporters.

Our special thanks go to BMO, our Title Sponsor, whose generous contribution helped bring this cultural celebration to life.

We also extend our heartfelt gratitude to our additional sponsors, donors, supporting artists, and volunteers for their invaluable contributions.

Their support demonstrates how meaningful partnerships can help preserve cultural heritage, encourage artistic participation, and enrich Winnipeg’s multicultural community.

Looking Forward

Starry SATB Choir remains committed to creating meaningful musical experiences that connect people across cultures and generations.

With the continued encouragement of community partners such as BMO, we look forward to expanding our cultural programming, supporting emerging musical talent, and bringing the joy of choral music to even more audiences.

Together, we celebrate music, embrace diversity, and build a stronger community.

Thank You, BMO!

Starry SATB Choir proudly recognizes BMO as the Title Sponsor of the Brilliant Starry – Dragon Boat Festival Concert 2026.

Your generous support helped make this celebration of Chinese culture, musical excellence, and community connection possible.

Starry SATB Choir — Connecting Cultures, Inspiring Communities, and Sharing the Joy of Music.

About the Concert

As the long winter settles in, the Starry Choir proudly presents its annual concert, Harmony Through the Years.

When voices rise in song, cultures draw closer together. This concert brings together several of Winnipeg's Chinese choirs, joined by a special guest Filipino choir, for an afternoon of music that crosses languages and art forms. The program features:

	•	Powerful multi-part choral performances
	•	A soaring tenor solo
	•	A pure and heartwarming children's choir

updates.title: ❤️🎶 Bringing Music, Joy, and Love to Our Seniors
updates.body:
Starry SATB Choir | Community Outreach Performance

At Starry SATB Choir, we believe that music is more than an art form—it is a powerful way to connect hearts, bridge generations, and bring joy to our community.

Our choir members and talented musicians came together to present a special musical performance for seniors at a local retirement residence in Winnipeg.

The program featured a beautiful variety of musical traditions, including performances on the Hulusi (Chinese gourd flute) and Erhu (traditional Chinese two-stringed instrument), heartfelt vocal solos, and choral arrangements.

🎵 Performance Highlights

Traditional Chinese Instruments

* A Beautiful Place — Hulusi performance by Ming Yang, Lisa Hou, and Sophie Liu
* White Horse and Horse Racing — Erhu performance by Ying Wang
* Ode to Pear Blossoms — Hulusi performance by Ming Yang, Lisa Hou, and Sophie Liu

Vocal Performances

* Tracks — Solo by Zixiang Yu
* I’m Willing — Solo by Xiaoyu Yang

Choral Performances

* The Song of Chile and The Moon Represents My Heart — Starry SATB Choir
* Amazing Grace — Starry SATB Choir together with the seniors

🌟 A Special Moment of Connection

One of the most meaningful moments of the event was our final performance of Amazing Grace, when choir members and seniors joined their voices together.

In that moment, music became a shared language, bringing people of different generations and cultural backgrounds together in harmony.

This performance was not simply about entertaining an audience. It was about sharing kindness, celebrating cultural diversity, and reminding our seniors that they are valued and appreciated.

We are deeply grateful to our dedicated volunteers and performers who generously contributed their time, energy, and musical talents to make this event possible.

❤️ Through music, we share love. Through volunteering, we strengthen our community.

Starry SATB Choir — Connecting Generations and Cultures Through Music.
